title: Deterministic template fallback runs through THE governed delivery-injection authority (delegated WOB-bound mission DL_4d48de10 no longer dies FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING)
description: Delegated WOB-bound missions hit the deterministic template fallback in makeServePlanner (BASE cf2674c emitted T1+optional T2/T3, NEVER TELEGRAM_DELIVERY) -> FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING (DL_4d48de10). Fix: ONE helper injectDeliveryTaskForTrueOmission (forge-strip -> requested+zero-canonical+zero-raw -> executorCapSets servable -> producer-presence proof -> stamped push) shared by canonicalize seam AND template tail. R1 (F1-F4): delivery key = next FREE T<n>; template delivery enforces the canonical current/external-data contract (intent + demand + no legitimate NETWORK_ACCESS gatherer -> FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_NETWORK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED); T2 verbatim embed byte-exact for no-intent; E6 derives wire bytes from real upstream. R2 (audit residual): canonical detector goalRequiresCurrentExternalData STRONG_CURRENCY_RE extended narrowly with 'tuần này|tuần hiện tại' + 'this week' — the exact incident goal now correctly demands current/external data and fails closed at PLANNING; the same combination rule (recency + research/retrieval + external subject) keeps scheduling/local/historical goals false. Test fixtures: E2/E3/E4b-e/E5/E6/E6b moved to HISTORICAL fixed-period intent goal (năm 2020); incident goal kept verbatim as negative fixture E9d (typed fail) + E9e integration (delegated WOB mission -> FAILED planning, zero minted requests, zero sends); E11 detector positive/negative matrix (tuần này + this week + exact goal vs historical/local/scheduling/no-intent). NO detector weakening, NO second detector in serve-planner, NO auto NETWORK_ACCESS grant. Untouched: external inputs, alias pinning, source-stamp, CAS, provenance, injection authority, fail-closed boundaries. 33/33 hotfix-d tests pass.
